Start year.note: A public notice from the Cologne district government dated 18 August 2025 says commissioning of the planned gas and steam plant is foreseen in 2029. GEM shows 2030.

Latest Activity.note: The same notice sets the public hearing on objections for 9 December 2025. I did not find a report that the hearing took place or of a permit decision. So this date is the newest dated step I found.

Status Detail.value: Permit application under review by the Cologne district government. Documents were on public display from 25 August to 24 September 2025. A public hearing was set for 9 December 2025. No permit decision found yet.
Status Detail.note: This is taken from the 18 August 2025 notice. There is no construction start, so the status stays pre-construction.

units.notes: Status stays pre-construction because no permit decision or construction start was found.
